avoid_supplements.name: Alcohol (ethanol)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Disulfiram-like reaction due to acetaldehyde accumulation; metronidazole inhibits aldehyde dehydrogenase
avoid_supplements.action: Strictly avoid all alcohol (including mouthwash, cough syrups) during therapy and for 48 hours after last dose

avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Induces CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, reducing metronidazole levels and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative herbal supplement

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: Metronidazole kills beneficial gut bacteria; probiotics may partially restore flora during/after therapy
caution_supplements.action: Consider starting 2-3 hours apart from metronidazole; consult provider for timing optimization

avoid_foods.name: Alcohol-containing foods (fermented products, vinegar-based dressings)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Ethanol content triggers disulfiram-like reaction similar to alcohol beverages
avoid_foods.action: Avoid foods with significant alcohol content; limit fermented items

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May alter absorption kinetics and delay peak plasma levels
caution_foods.action: Take metronidazole with or without food; consistent dosing schedule preferred

monitoring_notes: Monitor for disulfiram-like reactions (flushing, nausea, vomiting, headache) if alcohol exposure occurs. Assess for secondary infection risk due to microbiota disruption; counsel on gastrointestinal symptoms and potential C. difficile infection development.
